Help us Feed, Shelter and Heal Rescued Dogs.Hello friends, my name is MATOVU REAGAN and I run (Reagan Animals Care) at Kassanda Bukuya.

Our mission is simple but urgent: to rescue, feed, shelter and rehabilitate abandoned, abused and starving animals giving them a second chance of life.

Many rescued dogs are found emaciated,sick or injured left to survive on their own. We provide them with food, medical care,safe shelter, and love they have been at denied for too long.

BUT WE ARE FACING SERIOUS CHALLENGES;

1): Daily food costs for our animals.Feeding one dog

costs about $. Every day is a struggle.

2): Medical expenses for vaccinations, deworming, emergency treatment and spraying external parasites (ticks and fleas).

The Truth is, without your help, we can not continue to give these innocent souls the care they desperately need.
